title: Diyanet Vakfı text as revised for QuranEnc ("Dr. Ali Ozek and others")
author: Ali Özek et al. (revised under Rowad Translation Center)
translator: Ali Özek et al. (revised under Rowad Translation Center)
licence: QuranEnc.com terms: free non-commercial use with attribution, no modification; local research copy only.
notes: QuranEnc key "turkish_shahin" / fawaz "Muslim Shahin" is the TDV (Özek et al.) text revised for QuranEnc: ~60% identical to the TDV e-text (1:5 "Ancak sana ibadet (kulluk) eder ve ancak senden yardım isteriz"). The "Shahin" label does not name the translator. Cross-check over S1, S22, S87-114 (primary QuranEnc turkish_shahin) - fawazahmed0/quran-api tur-muslimshahin: n=373, exact 6.7%, loose 99.7%, sim 1.0; â/î/û in 19.8% of ayat (primary 19.8%); bracket counts differ in 1 ayat (e.g. 104:3); most divergent 104:3 (sim 0.98).
